entries.title: Residual-only start selection is not a safe discovery policy
entries.claim_not_supported: The smallest screening residuals reliably identify all important local-solver basins.
entries.observed_break_condition: A true basin can have unremarkable residuals away from its root while a boundary or nonzero local minimum has a very small residual.
entries.current_decision: Keep residual-only hard selection as a one-time negative control and forbid it as a production default.
entries.reopen_gate: A preregistered family-disjoint study must recover close and narrow basins without hard discard and pass the standard promotion gate.

entries.title: Hard APOSMM-like suppression can erase close roots
entries.claim_not_supported: Distance and value tests derived for separated minima safely suppress local launches in all-root geometry search.
entries.observed_break_condition: Close roots and several configurations sharing a target violate the separation intuition behind aggressive basin suppression.
entries.current_decision: Exclude hard suppression from M0-M4 and preserve an all-launch IID control plus a nonvanishing independent lane.
entries.reopen_gate: A soft emitter must pass close-root counterexamples and may not permanently discard starts.

entries.title: Naive homotopy and lifting are not general default improvements
entries.claim_not_supported: Adding a configuration homotopy or lifting every construction improves generic target recovery.
entries.observed_break_condition: Additional paths or variables can preserve the same basins, add conditioning cost and fail to repair strict-boundary attraction.
entries.current_decision: Reserve both mechanisms for a diagnosed failure family after the compiler/local baseline is stable.
entries.reopen_gate: A card must identify an applicability predicate and outperform the nested direct control on three unrelated families.

entries.title: Barrier proximity is not proof of strict-guard validity
entries.claim_not_supported: A penalty or barrier prevents invalid boundary-limit values from being reported as answers.
entries.observed_break_condition: Optimization can converge arbitrarily near a strict invalid boundary and produce a stable-looking target limit.
entries.current_decision: Keep guard semantics and uncertainty separate from residual minimization; M0-M4 candidates are not public validated answers.
entries.reopen_gate: Only a guard-aware experiment with canonical and validated sign separation may promote a production mechanism.

entries.title: Dynamic expression evaluation is not a production kernel
entries.claim_not_supported: A general dynamic evaluator is fast and constrained enough for repeated numerical oracle calls.
entries.observed_break_condition: Repeated name lookup, object construction and dynamic execution dominate cheap geometry arithmetic and complicate semantic control.
entries.current_decision: Use a clear reference interpreter and compare typed-plan/runtime-generated kernels with no input-supplied executable code.
entries.reopen_gate: No reopen is planned; any alternative must still satisfy the no-eval architecture invariant and compiler semantic gate.

entries.title: Up-front rank and condition routing did not justify its warm overhead
entries.claim_not_supported: A separate dense finite-difference rank and condition diagnostic can cheaply route between LM and trust-region local solvers.
entries.observed_break_condition: ROUTE-LMTR-A1 selected LM for only 11 of 1536 starts and gained 10 Gold-valid endpoints, while the diagnostic residuals and SVDs raised fully charged warm wall to 3.03 times the simple trust-region control.
entries.current_decision: Reject ROUTE-LMTR-A1, stop EXP-LOCAL-002 after its single tuning round, and leave locked inputs unmaterialized.
entries.reopen_gate: A new preregistered experiment must reuse solver-native Jacobian or progress state without a separate dense diagnostic and pass the same truth, work, and warm-wall gates.

entries.title: Sparse finite-difference coloring is not yet a general default
entries.claim_not_supported: Compiler-derived grouped finite differences should replace dense central differences as a general default solely because they reduce oracle callbacks on sparse graphs.
entries.observed_break_condition: EXP-JAC-001 preserved recall and had zero differential mismatches while reducing sparse-family oracle work by 43.81 percent, but dense-family warm overhead was 14.78 percent and cold coloring reached 25.48 percent of a 32-start run.
entries.current_decision: Keep coloring dormant and keep production dense; do not inspect the locked set or connect the candidate under the failed development gate.
entries.reopen_gate: A preregistered cached-coloring or applicability-routing experiment must retain the zero-mismatch fallback contract, pass the 5 percent dense and 1 percent cold-overhead gates, and then pass family-disjoint locked validation.

entries.title: CPQR subset success is not general singular-root evidence
entries.claim_not_supported: Passing target-aware column-subset refinement controls establishes configuration isolation or a general solver for singular and multiple roots.
entries.observed_break_condition: The successful S2 stratum has a rank-deficient feasible manifold and a target invariant along its numerical nullspace. Column-subset correction selects active coordinates but neither removes the free configuration direction nor tests isolated multiple-root convergence.
entries.current_decision: Retain S2 only as a product-disconnected specialized research candidate for stable target-constant rank-deficient strata, and continue to separately gated S3/S4 studies for isolated singular roots.
entries.reopen_gate: A general singular claim requires generator-disjoint isolated-multiple, tangency, close-root, manifold and nonroot controls with zero false promotion, independently covered target errors and locked validation.

entries.title: High-precision point replay is not root validation
entries.claim_not_supported: Re-evaluating unchanged coordinates in BigFloat and observing a small residual establishes a nearby root and an accurate target.
entries.observed_break_condition: A near-null relation direction can keep the residual below tolerance at a configuration with order-one target error; repeating that point at higher precision preserves the wrong coordinates.
entries.current_decision: Keep semantic point replay as an independent meaning check, but forbid it from constructing a public answer without separate numerical or validated root evidence.
entries.reopen_gate: Only a preregistered root-evidence mechanism that passes the fixed P1, manifold, metamorphic, family-disjoint locked and zero-false-promotion gates may add a promotion path.

entries.title: Restarted good-Broyden did not clear the singular development budget
entries.claim_not_supported: Stable rank/nullspace routing plus restarted multiprecision good-Broyden safely recovers isolated multiple-root endpoints within the frozen endpoint-wide 64-iteration budget.
entries.observed_break_condition: On the frozen 30-case S3 development split, both the finite-difference good-Broyden candidate and independently coded analytic inverse-secant control exhausted exactly 64 globally shared iterations on all 12 isolated/coalesced singular cases and recovered 0/12. The S1 baseline also promoted only one of three equivalent transforms of the closest regular-root control.
entries.current_decision: Reject S3 at its development gate. Do not retune the 64-iteration gate, open locked inputs, or connect S3 to production; any S4 bordered-nullspace study requires its own frozen development gate.
entries.reopen_gate: A new preregistered singular route must charge one endpoint-global work ledger, recover the generator-disjoint isolated/coalesced stratum, preserve all manifold/nonroot controls, and eliminate the close-root metamorphic disagreement before locked validation.

entries.title: Frozen archive-coupled DGN did not clear its development gate
entries.claim_not_supported: The frozen mixed-lane or fair-retry archive-coupled good deflated Gauss-Newton policy safely improves distinct-target recovery enough to justify derivative-realistic development.
entries.observed_break_condition: On the provenance-bound 48-case ideal-analytic-Jacobian development split, D1 and D2 each had zero prefix-64 full-target effect and no positive mechanistic signal. Both failed the zero-required safety gate and the cross-family repeat gate; neither executed a deflated step that yielded a new nonregular configuration. D1 preparation broke even only after about 6176 selected starts, while D2 had negative per-start preparation savings.
entries.current_decision: Reject the frozen v2 policies without using the available retune, materializing or opening locked inputs, or connecting production. Keep the result bounded to this candidate, input split, analytic-Jacobian mechanism and registered gate; it is not a global rejection of deflation.
entries.reopen_gate: A separate preregistered design must first eliminate all false/no-root canonical promotions, demonstrate a positive deflation-specific recovery signal across unrelated families, and establish preparation economics before any derivative-realistic or locked phase.

entries.title: Frozen S4 two-step refinement was not representation-stable enough for locked validation
entries.claim_not_supported: The frozen metadata-free C2 nullspace two-step map and applicability predicate recover at least 12 of 15 deflation-one endpoints with representation-invariant decisions and are ready for locked validation or production routing.
entries.observed_break_condition: Independent replay found 11/15 eligible recoveries for both the finite-difference candidate and analytic control. In the same four deflation-one groups, the orthogonal representation failed the final applicability audit while signed-permutation and equivalent-DAG representations promoted. Candidate/control decisions matched and S4 false promotions were zero, so the bounded failure is the shared stop/final-audit representation dependence, not finite-difference acquisition alone.
entries.current_decision: Reject the frozen S4 candidate without post-outcome retuning, locked-input materialization or product connection. Preserve its 73.3-point gain, zero S4 false promotions and analytic-control agreement as promising evidence for a separately preregistered successor.
entries.reopen_gate: A fresh family-disjoint study must use non-narrowing Gold assessment, persist the exact failing final subgate before returning unknown, use coordinate-stable scaling/audits, recover at least 12/15 with zero metamorphic disagreement, and preserve all control-strata, budget and false-promotion gates before locked validation.

entries.title: A pre-segment formal failure cannot support cached-Jacobian claims
entries.claim_not_supported: The EXP-JAC-003 launch establishes correctness, formal safety, efficacy or speed for the cached routed Jacobian candidate, or establishes that the candidate algorithm should be rejected.
entries.observed_break_condition: The frozen safety assessor rejected a JSON numeric-representation mismatch before K0 preflight, leaving zero ABBA segments and no terminal capture receipt. Independent host observation also recorded contention and a monitor failure. The later safety-only replay was post-outcome forensic diagnosis and cannot restore formal authority or supply missing control, timing or efficacy evidence.
entries.current_decision: Close EXP-JAC-003 without retry under the same ID. Keep locked validation and product connection false. Make no positive or negative algorithmic conclusion and no correctness, formal-safety, efficacy or speed claim from this attempt.
entries.reopen_gate: Use a new experiment ID with fresh preregistration and outcome-blind source freeze; prove the serialization/assessor contract before launch, obtain a clean uncontended host receipt, pass K0 replay and every safety preflight, and complete the registered ABBA development gate before considering locked validation or product connection.

entries.title: The frozen external trust-region configuration failed the T2 safety and critical-stratum gates
entries.claim_not_supported: The EXP-LOCAL-004 NLS-TR configuration is a general local champion whose measured signal authorizes a native trust-region implementation or production routing.
entries.observed_break_condition: On 48 open development cases and 32 paired starts, NLS-TR raised safe-full by 10.42 family-equal points but returned 62 accepted Gold-inconsistent endpoints, regressed strict-boundary safe-full from 6/6 to 5/6, repeated a strict safe-full gain in only two unrelated families, and consumed 1.379 times the primary-control callback work.
entries.current_decision: Reject this external configuration at T2 and do not implement its native TR port or connect it to production. Preserve only the bounded recall signal; this is not a rejection of trust-region methods as a class.
entries.reopen_gate: A fresh general TR candidate must use the common condition-aware endpoint correction and 512/768-bit confirmation, eliminate accepted ambiguity and boundary regressions, repeat safe-full gains in at least three unrelated families, and pass the registered work gate on a newly frozen study.

entries.title: The frozen deterministic DFO-LS configuration failed its T0 efficacy and work gates
entries.claim_not_supported: The EXP-LOCAL-005 deterministic native-bound DFO-LS configuration is a general local improvement that should advance to T1 or remain as a production dependency.
entries.observed_break_condition: On the clean five-case T0 screen, DFO-LS reduced qualified target recovery from 4/10 to 3/10, left safe-full unchanged at 2/5, used 2.507 times the primary-control callback work and hit 16 local caps. It recovered neither Warped target map nor the NearRank case, although accepted-endpoint safety violations were zero.
entries.current_decision: Reject this configuration before T1, remove its code and Python/Julia dependencies from the final tree, and retain only the provenance-bound decision and artifact hashes. This is not a rejection of DFO-LS, derivative-free least squares or MADS as classes.
entries.reopen_gate: A new derivative-free candidate must define a distinct general mechanism, preserve hidden-invalid semantics and native bounds, improve safe-full or reduce callback work by at least 20 percent at noninferior safety/recall, and repeat its signal in at least three unrelated families before T2.

entries.title: The frozen native-bound SciPy TRF configuration failed its T0 efficacy and NearRank gates
entries.claim_not_supported: The EXP-LOCAL-006 SciPy exact-SVD reflective trust-region configuration is a general local improvement that should advance to T1, be ported natively, or remain as a production dependency.
entries.observed_break_condition: At the clean 4,800-callback T0 threshold, the candidate recovered 3/10 qualified targets versus 4/10 for the primary control, left safe-full unchanged at 2/5, regressed NearRank from 1/1 to 0/1 and used 1.001 times the callback work. It correctly rejected every accepted-endpoint safety hazard but hit 18 local caps.
entries.current_decision: Reject this frozen configuration before T1, remove its code and Python/Julia dependencies, and retain the provenance-bound decision and artifact hashes. This is not a rejection of reflective trust regions or trust-region methods as classes.
entries.reopen_gate: A new trust-region experiment must change a general mechanism such as branch-stable model agreement, derivative information, or invariant singular correction; it must not merely wrap another dense TR implementation, and must pass the common safety, stratum, work and unrelated-family gates.

entries.title: Compiled geometry callback snapshot did not establish a whole-solver speedup
entries.claim_not_supported: A semantically equivalent compiled geometry callback snapshot is a production-wide solver speedup.
entries.observed_break_condition: The 131-case callback same-work measurement improved callback wall by 7.25% with zero mismatches, but the completed whole-solver seed-0 A1/B1 pair was correctness-neutral and 0.82% slower by the registered geometric-mean wall metric; the five-seed serial ABBA gate was interrupted after candidate B2 case 6/145.
entries.current_decision: Do not promote the snapshot, update qualification, build a production wheel, or merge to main. Preserve the callback implementation and bounded evidence as a non-promoted local optimization result; do not claim a whole-solver speedup.
entries.reopen_gate: Only a new, separately preregistered experiment may reopen this mechanism, with a complete five-seed serial ABBA, safety and recall non-regression, family-clustered end-to-end speed confidence, jobs=7 RSS and throughput, and full wheel, doctor and fallback verification.
